texts.title: Please Read
texts.content:
THIRD FLOOR: SILENT STUDY
Phones on silent
No group work or phone calls
Food is not allowed; covered drinks are fine
Need to talk? Group study rooms are available on the second floor and can be booked at the front desk

questions.stem: What are students allowed to do on the third floor?
options: C. Work together in small groups
D. Drink from a covered cup
questions.explanation: The sign says "Food is not allowed; covered drinks are fine."

questions.stem: Where would the sign most likely be posted?
questions.explanation: It refers to a "silent study" floor and "group study rooms" booked "at the front desk," which suggests a library.
